answer:
Motorist deaths exceeded cyclist deaths every year, with the largest gap in 2020 (139 vs. 29) and the smallest in 2019 (82 vs. 31).

The line-chart view shows motorist deaths peaking at 139 in 2020 and cyclist deaths peaking at 31 in both 2019 and 2023.

The annual excess of motorist deaths ranged from 51 in 2019 to 110 in 2020, and was 58 in 2025.
